_meta.purpose: Seed mapping from Indian Standards to mandatory certification schemes.
_meta.caveat: QCO coverage changes by gazette notification. Every rule here must be re-verified against the live BIS/MeitY notification lists before being relied on for compliance decisions. The pipeline surfaces these as 'flags to check', never as legal determinations.

authorities.BIS_PRODUCT_CERT: BIS (Conformity Assessment) Regulations 2018, Scheme-I (ISI Mark), issued under product-specific Quality Control Orders
authorities.CRS: Compulsory Registration Scheme — Electronics & IT Goods (Requirements for Compulsory Registration) Order, MeitY; administered by BIS
authorities.HALLMARKING: BIS (Hallmarking) Regulations 2018 read with the Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery QCO

rules.notes: Safety of information technology equipment — laptops, monitors, printers, power adapters, mobile phones. Core CRS standard.
Audio, video and similar electronic apparatus — safety requirements.
Secondary cells and batteries containing alkaline/non-acid electrolytes — portable sealed cells, lithium batteries.
Self-ballasted LED lamps for general lighting services.
Safety of lamp controlgear / LED drivers.
LED modules and luminaires for general lighting.
PVC insulated cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 V — under Electric Cables QCO.
rules.authority: Electric Wires, Cables, Appliances and Protection Devices QCO

rules.notes: PVC insulated heavy duty electric cables.
Safety of household and similar electrical appliances.
Plugs and socket-outlets of rated voltage up to and including 250 V.
Switches for domestic and similar purposes.
Grades of gold and gold alloys, jewellery/artefacts — hallmarking basis.
Hallmarking of gold jewellery — marking requirements.
Hallmarking of silver jewellery and artefacts.
